name: Strahd Zombie

source.note: converted to the 2024 stat block format

languages: the languages it knew in life (understands but can't speak)

traits.name: Loathsome Limbs
traits.summary: Taking 5+ Bludgeoning or Slashing damage at once can sever a leg, an arm or the head, which fight on.
traits.text: Each time the zombie takes 5 or more Bludgeoning or Slashing damage from a single source, roll 1d20. 1-8: it loses a leg, if it has one left. 9-16: it loses an arm, if it has one left. 17-20: its head is cut off. Severed parts keep acting on the zombie's initiative with their own action and movement until the zombie drops to 0 Hit Points, at which point every part dies. A severed part has AC 8, and damage dealt to it is subtracted from the zombie's Hit Points. A severed leg can't attack and has a Speed of 5 feet. A severed arm has a Speed of 5 feet and can make one Claw attack on its turn, with Disadvantage; the body loses one Claw attack from its Multiattack for each arm it has lost. A severed head has a Speed of 0 feet and can make a Bite attack only against a target in its own space; the body loses its Bite and has the Blinded condition unless the head can see it. Missing one leg halves the zombie's Speed; missing both gives it the Prone condition, after which it can crawl if it has both arms, crawl at half Speed with one arm, and has a Speed of 0 (and can't gain Speed bonuses) with no arms or legs.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: Tears at a target with a clawed hand.

summary: Lurches in for a bite and two claws; cutting it apart only spawns crawling limbs that keep fighting.
